recall.minute: Summarisation = abridged text keeping key information (TL;DR: 150 emails, 60-page report; snippets ~26 words, action items, digests, accessibility). Output: extractive (highlighter) vs abstractive (pen); input: single (lead sentence strong for news) vs multi-document (overlap, contradictions, redundancy); focus: generic vs query-focused (movable type in Korea?). Extractive pipeline: content selection → information ordering → sentence realisation; no invented facts. Selection: Luhn 1958 frequency → TF-IDF weight = TF × IDF; LexRank: cosine similarity graph + PageRank (cocktail party; central sentence wins); MMR = argmax λ·Sim(s, Q) − (1 − λ)·max Sim(s, sⱼ), greedy until length K (Rowling: S1 0.90, S2 0.88 near-duplicate → λ = 0.5 picks S1 then S3). Ordering: chronological, coherence, templates (biography: dates → nationality → education → fame; definition: genus → species → synonym → subtype; medical: population → problem → intervention → outcome). Realisation: prune attribution ('international observers said Tuesday'), appositives, initial adverbials; resolve 'He' → Gen. Augusto Pinochet. Abstractive: RNNs forget long input → seq2seq + attention → Transformers; ARTICLE <EOS> SUMMARY <EOS> <pad>, loss on summary only; hallucination risk. ROUGE-N recall of reference n-grams with clipping: water spinach bigrams 3 + 3 + 6 = 12 of 10 + 10 + 9 = 29 → 0.41; rewards wording, not meaning.
